objective: Preserve the Learning owner's frozen 2022 ASQ Certified Six Sigma Green Belt source contract and close the machine-readable requirement/prerequisite/subskill/assessment graph schema before populating all 66 source-bound requirement nodes.

source_contract.version_rule: The compiler remains bound to the frozen 2022 source contract unless Learning owner authority explicitly migrates it. A newer public ASQ Body of Knowledge must be treated as version-drift/revalidation evidence, never silently substituted for the frozen source.
source_contract.drift_rule: Observed public-source revision may trigger provenance review and selective invalidation analysis, but cannot rewrite frozen requirement identities or content without explicit version migration authority.

requirement_node_schema.source_text_rule: Store governed source locators and digests/references. Do not invent or reconstruct missing copyrighted source text from a newer public version.

required_checks: exactly 66 unique requirement_id values are present
every requirement node resolves to exactly one frozen-2022 source locator and provenance reference
no required node is silently sourced from a newer ASQ revision
hard prerequisite edges are acyclic or an explicit owner-approved cycle-break classification is present
every subskill is reachable from at least one requirement node
every assessment profile is bound to one or more requirement/subskill targets
every requirement has workplace relevance, mastery, delayed-retention and novel-transfer profile schema
human-observed response, retention, transfer and effectiveness fields remain UNOBSERVED until real authorized evidence exists
version drift causes selective revalidation flags rather than automatic wholesale replacement
unknown or unresolved source mappings fail closed and remain explicit

completion_delta: Before: the Learning compiler objective required a full 66-requirement source-bound graph, but the safe overnight path still needed an explicit version-lock and schema checkpoint to prevent current public ASQ revisions from silently changing the frozen 2022 contract. After: the 2022 source version is explicitly locked, current public ASQ material is classified only as drift/revalidation evidence, the requirement-node and edge schemas are closed, deterministic validation/failure classes are defined, and the next machine-safe unit of work is exact 66-node population from preserved 2022 evidence.
stop_condition: SATISFIED for the source-version-lock and graph-schema subphase. No claim is made that all 66 requirement nodes have been populated or validated yet.
evidence_target: 66 unique source-bound requirement nodes from preserved frozen-2022 evidence
deterministic graph validation report with zero unresolved missing IDs or silent version substitutions
explicit unresolved/cycle/provenance findings if any remain
next bounded implementation contract only after graph validation closes
forbidden_authority: do not infer or fabricate learner consent, responses, retention, transfer or effectiveness evidence
do not claim certification equivalence or certification outcome
do not silently migrate from the frozen 2022 standard source to a newer public ASQ revision
do not claim native-platform or production evidence
do not transfer A-01 PASS or claim A-01 authority from research/specification work
continuation_rule: Populate and validate all 66 requirement nodes from preserved frozen-2022 evidence. If a source locator cannot be proven, mark it unresolved and continue all independent graph work. After graph closure, bind the smallest bounded compiler implementation successor and obtain fresh exact-SHA qualification for any changed software.
